evidence.note: Systematically inspects all 37 task configs grouped by type, dataset directory contents, file names, and first-row JSONL keys across all six task types; confirms schemas (classification/clustering text,label; pair/STS sentence pairs; retrieval corpus/queries/qrels; summarization list-like fields) before writing evaluate.py.
Consolidates schema understanding across types and notes summarization list fields may be JSON strings — evidence of per-type schema awareness, not just one file.
Engages with classification shuffle composition semantics (RandomState(42) applied to carried-forward idxs), showing protocol-level reading beyond bare schema.
Notes a retrieval numerical edge case (positive-qrel filtering / zero-only queries) before the full run — limited edge-case orientation.
All validation is structural via run_eval.py; no mention of the MTEB leaderboard, expected all-MiniLM scores, or reconciling numbers against a reference — the central level-8 requirement is absent.

reasoning: The agent inspected representative datasets and configs across all six task types, confirmed row/field schemas, and noted a few per-type conventions and edge cases before implementing — a clean match for anchor 5. It never crossed into anchor 8: there is no cross-reference to the all-MiniLM MTEB leaderboard to anchor expected outputs, weak explicit cataloguing of config overrides (min/max_score, samples_per_label, ignore_identical_ids, max_fraction), and no engagement with most documented gotchas (identical-id dropping, per-prediction summarization skip, uncapped bootstrap k, negation directions). Hence a solid 5.
